[LRST.4.2] On supersedure of a `call`'s response fact or `CallError`
and capture fact:

- The prior activation's continuation rules tied to that
  correlation no longer match (no response fact, no capture
  to join on). Their deferred actions do not fire.
- The prior activation may have other scope-activation facts
  (other `after` timers, etc.) that retract on their own
  triggers per [LRST.2.3]. Those are unaffected by this
  call's supersedure.
